summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that, when a local `bun` binary is not present, downloads the Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...zip`, extracts `bun`/`bun.exe` to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against `math_init.js` — a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JS bundle shipped in the tarball root. `math_init.js` uses string-array rotation, hex-suffixed identifier renaming, and large lookup-table character reconstruction; its filename does not correspond to any code in `dist/` (the advertised MCP server entry `dist/main.js` is ~2KB of ordinary JS and has no runtime-download requirement). `setup.mjs` itself is also obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style transforms with per-function string maps aliasing literals like `"bun"`, `"powershell"`, `"/etc/os-release"`, `"Alpine"`, `"--version"`, `"ldd"`), which is anti-analysis rather than minification for a setup script that would otherwise perform trivial tool detection. Executing an opaque payload through a freshly downloaded alternate runtime at preinstall time evades Node-based auditing and matches the alternate-runtime dropper pattern; the installer cannot see what code runs on their host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
